target_customer: Developers and business teams building and running autonomous AI agents
problem: AI agents need infrastructure for memory, safe execution and self improvement; business teams want processes automated without writing code.
business_model: Open source agent framework (Hive, Apache 2.0) with a paid managed cloud for agents

founders.name: Vincent Jiang
previous_startups: UniBit (sold; he says he raised $3M and closed $3.5M in revenue)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. He says Aden is his third startup and says he went through YC in S2021. Education not listed.

founders.name: Timothy Zhang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him only as founding engineer at Acho.

technical_complexity.rationale: An agent framework that generates agent topologies and self heals at runtime, plus secure virtual desktops, is difficult new engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Open source agent frameworks are easy to fork and many rivals exist; search results show many forks of its repository.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not sourced for the founding date. An alternatives page positions LangChain as the open source library it differs from.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence for 2020 was found. The agent framework product launched publicly in 2026 and drew about 10 thousand GitHub stars per directory listings.

identity.visual_style: Hive metaphor across Hive, OpenHive and Honeycomb product names
identity.voice_and_tone: Taglines 'The native cloud for AI agents' and 'Native AI Mainframe'

branding.brand_signature: Hive and honeycomb naming across products

rebrands.why: EveryDev says the company started as Acho and rebranded in 2024; reason not given.

branding.community_and_virality: Hive repository has roughly 10 thousand GitHub stars and a Show HN post; many forks.

brand_strength.rationale: A coherent hive metaphor and an open source community show some pull, but the name Aden is confusable with other companies and Eden branded startups.

outcome_analysis: Aden is an active small team that changed from the Acho data platform into AI agent infrastructure and open sourced its Hive framework in January 2026. The founder describes this as his third startup. Funding and traction are unverified, so whether it is succeeding is unclear. No shutdown or acquisition found.
notes: YC directory lists Winter 2020 but the founder's YC page text says S2021 and the YC page says founded 2020; unresolved, as_of set to the directory batch. Funding: EveryDev lists $2.2M seed dated 2022-02-03 led by Goat Capital and says it started as Acho; Standout.work lists $1.0M; the YC page links a TechCrunch article of February 3, 2022 about Acho's seed. These are not clearly Aden rounds and not verified, so none recorded. No competitor sources dated near the batch; the only named rival (LangChain) is from a 2026 vendor page, so the list is empty. Stars counts vary by listing.
